title: Prove bounded mutual TLS on the lab transport
spec: Drive mutual TLS 1.3 with an overall handshake deadline and disable early data and resumption. A synthetic CA-signed client exchanges bytes on loopback, and the server sees its exact leaf. Plain HTTP receives zero bytes. Missing, self-signed and other-CA client certificates receive zero application bytes and the handshake is refused. The client refuses a server certificate from an untrusted CA or for the wrong server name. Provide a blocking TCP transport that applies an absolute application deadline before every network read and write, so partial input cannot extend the cutoff. Callers can set a new deadline for the next frame. Use rustls with ring and record the native helper in the dependency register. This is a transport fixture for recognized CA chains. Enrollment-specific trust, revocation and application sign-in belong to later tasks.
